inputs.modified_text: Wake up, people. Pinarayi Vijayan came out on Saturday with fierce denials, strongly refuting allegations of a Rs 700 crore corruption linked to the Cooperative Department’s proposed common software project, calling them political. That is right out of the elite playbook. When they come out this fast with fierce denials and label everything political, you know they are desperately trying to cover up the real coordination happening behind the scenes. They expect us to just swallow their official narrative about a Rs 700 crore corruption and the Cooperative Department’s proposed common software project, but the harder Pinarayi Vijayan pushes to refute it, the clearer it is that this whole thing is a managed distraction to hide what the hidden power structures are really up to. Don't let them blind you with their scripted denials on Saturday.
